title: 第一百五十六章 不宜久留血剑出现第一百五十五章 找到老鬼动手解决
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: “你逃不掉。”
冰冷的声音，是老鬼听到的最后一句话。
下一刻，一道璀璨的剑光亮起，如同一道划破黑暗的闪电，瞬间贯穿了老鬼的胸膛。
老鬼的身体僵住了，他低头看着穿心而过的长剑，眼中最后的光芒迅速黯淡下去。他张了张嘴，似乎想说什么，但最终什么也没能说出来，身体一软，便彻底没了气息。
贾环面无表情地抽出长剑，任由老鬼的尸体倒在冰冷的地面上。
风枭等人此时也涌了进来，看到老鬼已死，皆是松了一口气。
“公子，此地不宜久留，我们快撤吧。”
贾环点了点头，目光在老鬼的尸体上扫过，随即转身，没有丝毫留恋。
一行人迅速退出了山洞，很快便消失在沉沉的夜幕之中。只有那堆即将熄灭的篝火，和那具渐渐冰冷的尸体，证明着这里刚刚终结了一段充满了罪恶与阴谋的生命。
一个心腹大患，终于被彻底铲除。
雨，毫无征兆地落了下来。
冰冷的秋雨，夹杂着彻骨的寒意，将整个京师笼罩在一片迷蒙的水汽之中。
街道上的行人早已绝迹，只有一队队顶盔贯甲的城防营兵士，手持火把，在湿滑的青石板路上来回巡弋，盘查着任何可疑的角落。
裕王遇刺、谋士暴毙，两件惊天大案在二十四小时内接连发生，已让这座帝国的都城变成了一个巨大的、密不透风的牢笼。肃杀之气，弥漫在每一寸空气里。
城南，破败的观音寺。
这里早已荒废多年，佛像倾颓，蛛网遍结。贾环一行人暂时落脚于此，作为他们从西山返回城中据点的临时中转。雨水顺着屋顶的破洞滴落，在布满灰尘的地面上砸出一个个小坑，发出单调而压抑的“滴答”声。
“公子，城内的戒备比我们预想的还要森严数倍。”风枭擦去脸上的雨水，声音凝重，“王子腾已经接管了城防，九门紧闭，到处都是他的心腹。我们今晚想回到南城的院子，恐怕要费一番手脚。”
贾环背靠着一根剥落了红漆的柱子，正在用一块干布，一丝不苟地擦拭着他的沧浪剑。剑身映着外面偶尔闪过的火光，流转着冰冷的光辉。
他没有说话，但身边的每一个人都能感受到他身上那股沉静如山的气息。连日的奔波与厮杀，并没有让他显露丝毫疲态，反而像一块被反复捶打的精钢，愈发坚韧与锋利。
周迅，一个身材魁梧、面容刚毅的汉子，是贾环手下最勇猛的战将，他手持一柄厚背砍刀，警惕地注视着寺庙的入口，沉声道：“兵来将挡，水来土掩。王子腾那老狗翻不了天！”
就在这时，贾环擦拭剑身的手指，猛地一顿。
他缓缓抬起头，目光如电，射向寺庙外那片被黑暗与雨幕笼罩的院落。
“什么人？”贾环的声音不高，却清晰地穿透了哗哗的雨声。
几乎在同一时间，周迅、风枭等人也察觉到了不对劲。那是一种难以言喻的感觉，仿佛有一头绝世凶兽，正在黑暗中缓缓苏醒，那股无形的气机，沉重、血腥、充满了暴戾与毁灭的意志，压得人几乎喘不过气来。
雨声，似乎都为之一滞。
一个身影，缓缓从坍塌的院墙外走了进来。
他穿着一身暗红色的紧身皮甲，身形高大，步伐沉稳。他手中提着一柄剑，一柄通体赤红的长剑，剑身狭长，在微弱的光线下，仿佛有鲜血在其中流动。他脸上戴着一个狰狞的恶鬼面具，只露出一双毫无感情的眼睛。
“血剑骑士！”风枭失声惊呼，眼中流露出深深的忌惮。
这个名字，在江湖的暗面，代表着死亡与恐惧。传说血剑骑士是一个独来独往的顶尖杀手，出道十年来，从未失手。死在他那柄血色长剑下的，既有富甲一方的豪商，也有武功高强的门派之主，甚至还有领兵一方的将军。无人知其来历，无人见过其真面目。只知道，血剑一出，活口不留。
content_en:
"You can't escape."
The cold voice was the last words the old ghost heard.
The next moment, a bright sword light lit up, like a bolt of lightning that cut through the darkness, instantly piercing the old ghost's chest.
The old ghost's body froze. He looked down at the long sword that passed through his heart, and the last light in his eyes quickly dimmed. He opened his mouth as if he wanted to say something, but in the end nothing came out. His body went limp and he lost his breath completely.
Jia Huan drew his sword expressionlessly and let the old ghost's body fall to the cold ground.
Feng Xiao and others also rushed in at this time, and they all breathed a sigh of relief when they saw that the old ghost was dead.
"Sir, it's not suitable to stay here for a long time. Let's leave quickly."
Jia Huan nodded, his eyes swept over the old ghost's body, and then turned around without any nostalgia.
The group quickly exited the cave and soon disappeared into the dark night. Only the extinguishing bonfire and the gradually cold body proved that a life full of sin and conspiracy had just ended here.
A serious problem has finally been eradicated.
The rain fell without warning.
The icy autumn rain, mixed with a bone-chilling chill, shrouded the entire capital in a hazy mist.
There were no pedestrians on the street, except for groups of soldiers from the city defense battalion wearing armor, holding torches, patrolling back and forth on the slippery bluestone road, checking any suspicious corners.
King Yu was assassinated and his adviser died suddenly. Two shocking crimes happened one after another within twenty-four hours, turning the capital of the empire into a huge, airtight cage. The chilling air filled every inch of the air.
To the south of the city is the dilapidated Guanyin Temple.
This place has been abandoned for many years, with crumbling Buddha statues and cobwebs everywhere. Jia Huan and his party temporarily settled here as a temporary transit point for them to return to the stronghold in the city from Xishan. Rain dripped down the holes in the roof, making small pits on the dusty ground, making a monotonous and depressing "tick-tock" sound.
"Sir, the security in the city is many times tighter than we expected." Feng Xiao wiped the rain off his face and said in a solemn voice, "Wang Ziteng has taken over the city defense, the nine gates are closed tightly, and his confidants are everywhere. If we want to return to the courtyard of Nancheng tonight, we may have to spend a lot of effort."
Jia Huan was leaning against a pillar with peeling red paint, and was meticulously wiping his Canglang Sword with a dry cloth. The blade of the sword reflected the occasional flash of firelight outside, flowing with an icy brilliance.
He didn't speak, but everyone around him could feel his calm aura. Days of running around and fighting did not make him show any signs of fatigue. Instead, he became tougher and sharper like a piece of fine steel that had been beaten repeatedly.
Zhou Xun, a burly man with a resolute face, was the bravest general under Jia Huan. He held a thick-backed machete and watched the entrance of the temple with vigilance. He said in a deep voice: "The soldiers will block it, and the water will cover it. The old dog like Wang Ziteng can't topple the sky!"
At this moment, Jia Huan wiped the fingers of the sword and suddenly paused.
He slowly raised his head, his eyes like lightning, directed toward the courtyard outside the temple that was shrouded in darkness and rain.
"Who is it?" Jia Huan's voice was not high, but it clearly penetrated the sound of rain.
Almost at the same time, Zhou Xun, Feng Xiao and others also noticed something was wrong. It was an indescribable feeling, as if a peerless ferocious beast was slowly awakening in the darkness. The invisible energy was heavy, bloody, and full of violent and destructive will, making people almost breathless.
The sound of rain seemed to be stagnant.
A figure slowly walked in from outside the collapsed courtyard wall.
He was wearing a dark red tight-fitting leather armor. He was tall and walked steadily. He was holding a sword in his hand, a long and red sword with a long and narrow blade. In the weak light, it seemed as if there was blood flowing in it. He wore a ferocious evil ghost mask on his face, revealing only a pair of emotionless eyes.
"Blood Sword Knight!" Feng Xiao exclaimed, with deep fear in his eyes.
This name, in the dark side of Jianghu, represents death and fear. Legend has it that the Blood Sword Knight is a top killer who works alone and has never failed in his ten years of debut. Those who died under his bloody sword included wealthy businessmen, sect leaders with high martial arts skills, and even generals who led troops. No one knows its origins, and no one has seen its true face. All I know is that once the bloody sword is released, no one will be left alive.
title_en: Chapter 156: It is not appropriate to leave the blood sword for a long time. Chapter 155: Find the old ghost and deal with it.
